build_vqvae_codebook_layer: build a VQ-VAE codebook layer with a specified number of embeddings and embedding dimension
create_codebook_quantization: create a codebook that quantizes encoder outputs via nearest-neighbor lookup in the embedding space
test_codebook_forward_pass: test the Codebook forward pass by passing encoder output tensors and retrieving quantized embeddings
review_codebook_ema_update: review the Codebook class and its exponential moving average embedding update mechanism
summarize_codebook_lookup: summarize the Codebook lookup method that retrieves embeddings by index from the codebook
